availability.bulkHint: Choose whether you can or cannot help, then press the group of dates it applies to. You can correct individual dates afterwards.
privacy.notice: We store your name, your contact address, and when you can help.
privacy.title: Your information
privacy.what: We store your name, your contact address, which activities you can run, when you can help, and which slots you have taken.
privacy.why: We use it only to build the schedule. There is no tracking, no analytics and no third parties.
privacy.who: Planners and administrators at 4water can see your details. Other volunteers can see your name on the plan.
privacy.calendar: If you create a calendar link, the link itself is what grants access — a calendar app cannot log in. Anyone you give it to, or who finds it, can see when you are helping. It is yours to replace or switch off at any time on your own page, and doing so stops the old link working immediately.
privacy.rights: You can always see and correct your own details. If you want them deleted, contact an administrator.
admin.eraseHint: Anonymising strips the name and contact details but keeps who ran what. Removing entirely deletes the person; their past slots then read as unfilled.
admin.exportSeason: Download the season as a spreadsheet
admin.retentionHint: We keep {seasons} seasons and delete messages older than {days} days. The clean-up runs automatically each night alongside the backup.

profile.badContact: That does not look like an email address.
profile.contactTaken: Somebody else already uses that address.

status.title: Status
status.hint: This page answers the questions people have when something looks wrong.
status.seasonEnded: Season {key} ended {ended}. That is why the plan looks empty — create the next season under Administration.
status.seasonFuture: Season {key} has not started yet; it begins {starts}.
status.seasonMissing: Season {key} is in the configuration but not in the database.
status.gaps: {n} of {of} slots in the next month are unfilled.
status.silent: {n} of {of} active volunteers have not answered about availability yet.
status.queued: {n} messages are queued (no webhook is configured).
status.backupAge: The newest backup is {hours} hours old. {kept} kept.
status.backupNone: There are no backups at all. See RUNBOOK.
calendar.name: {app} — my shifts
calendar.title: Your shifts in your own calendar
calendar.what: Subscribe once and your shifts show up in the calendar app on your phone, updating on their own when something changes. Add it as a subscribed calendar by URL — not as a one-off import, or it will never update.
calendar.created: Your calendar link is ready. Copy it now — it is shown only once.
calendar.revoked: The calendar link no longer works. Anyone still subscribed will stop seeing your shifts.
calendar.copyNow: Copy this now. It is shown only this once.
calendar.prefix: Put the site address in front of it — the part before /me in your browser's address bar. Your calendar app needs the whole address, not just this part.
calendar.secret: Treat it like a password: anyone who has this link can see when you are helping. Lost it, or shared it by mistake? Replace it — the old link stops working immediately.
calendar.alreadyOn: A calendar link exists. It cannot be shown again, so replace it if you no longer have it.
calendar.noTimezone: No time zone is set up for this department yet, so times in the calendar will be in UTC and may look wrong. Ask an administrator to set it.
outbox.title: Messages
outbox.noWebhook: No chat webhook is configured, so nothing here was actually delivered. The text is kept so you can copy it into the group chat yourself — and so nobody assumes people were told when they were not.
outbox.truncated: Showing the {shown} most relevant. {n} older messages are not shown.
outbox.retention: Messages are deleted automatically after the retention period. See the privacy notice.
status.oidcDiscovery: Sign-in reads the identity provider's own endpoint list.
status.oidcFallback: Sign-in could not read the provider's endpoint list and is guessing NextCloud's usual addresses: {why}
admin.rolloverHint: The next season starts empty. Volunteers, their activities and the weekly rhythm carry over — only slots and availability reset. Correct the name and dates before saving if they are wrong.
admin.weeklyHint: Which days and times have activities, and what happens in each slot. You can have several slots on the same day.
admin.weeklyUsed: {n} dates this season use this slot.
admin.weeklyRemoved: The slot is removed. Dates already created stay as they are.
admin.weeklyAdded: The slot is added. {n} new dates created from today onward.
